description: Check whether one domain name is available to register at pekt, a Norwegian domain service, and what it costs: first-year and renewal price in NOK per year including 25 % Norwegian VAT. If the extension is not sold, the reason is given. Always show the user the returned buy_url.

name.description: Domain with its extension, e.g. example.no. A bare name such as example is checked as example.no. Unicode names such as blåbær.no are fine.

name: check_domain
title: Check if a domain is available and what it costs
